library.name: CodeMirror 6
library.description: The code editor behind the workspace, bundled with grammars for every language it offers: Java and R from @codemirror/legacy-modes 6.5.4, and @codemirror/lang-javascript 6.2.5, lang-html 6.4.12, lang-css 6.3.1, lang-python 6.2.1, lang-cpp 6.0.3 and lang-rust 6.0.2. Moodle core ships CodeMirror for the TinyMCE HTML plugin, but that module exports only HTML, JavaScript and XML languages and none of the extension API, so a Java, Python, C++, Rust or R editor cannot be built on it. Rebuilt with build/build.sh.
